LENS LANGUAGE
Portrait compression and shallow backgrounds for intimate studies; standard perspective for full-length fashion.
LIGHTING
One clearly defined approach per image: amber street light, soft studio diffusion, or directional cinema light.
COMPOSITION
Protect hair silhouettes, jewelry and garment details. Give each photograph room to breathe.
